name: mcp-new-company-registrations-feed
description: MCP server for New Company Registrations Feed. Find companies newly registered in UK Companies House, Norway Brreg, Finland PRH, and France BODACC, filtered by date, industry code, activity, name, and place: one row per company with number, type, address, and industry. Runs on Apify. Clay-ready output.

apify_token.title: Apify API Token
apify_token.description: Apify API token for running the actor

companies_house_api_key.title: Companies House API key
companies_house_api_key.description: Optional. Your own free UK Companies House REST API key. Without it the UK register is skipped.
